status: Feature list CONFIRMED as the working backlog (owner approval 2026-10-25); order and wording PROPOSED. Agents change only 'passes' and 'evidence'; only the director adds, removes or reorders features (docs/director/README.md).

owners.art: thread 'Build fur and creature archetype parts'
owners.audio: thread 'Score lush music and stage audio'

features.feature: Director's office in the repo: handbook, rubrics, backlog, progress log, templates
Playtest capture: one script plays each stage's smoke flow under xvfb and writes frames at gameplay camera plus a metrics JSON (time to first part, editor visits, threat encounters, deaths)
Visual reference package: creature turnaround, three compatible variants, habitat composition, material sphere sheet, scale lineup, lighting test, with clay and beauty renders
In-engine benchmark scene and comparison frames at gameplay camera, 1920x1080, Forward+ on the RTX 5070; owner approval recorded in DECISIONS.md
Placeholder inventory down to functional systems only; every gameplay mesh in the cell, aquatic and creature stages scores 3+ on every visual rubric axis
Performance budget set and measured: 60 fps at 1080p on the baseline PC in the worst-case scene of each stage; minimum spec proposed
Same-scenario comparisons: three creature body plans run the same seeded scenario and show distinct strengths and costs (speed, reach, defence, stamina)
Reliable locomotion at extreme supported proportions: no foot sliding or invalid poses across the presets and random creatures (gait tests plus frames)
Cell and aquatic body choices show the same tradeoff discipline: a heavier body is slower and tougher, measured in the balance lab
Cell top size exits into the Aquatic stage through EraTransition with a .pre-aquatic checkpoint (era boundary needs owner approval)
Aquatic shore exit reuses ShoreLink and EraTransition into the creature stage with a .pre-terrestrial checkpoint
One save carries a lineage from cell to sea to land: lineage id, genome, generation, discoveries and relationships survive both transitions, a save, a reload and a death
Windows acceptance scenario for the continuity run: fresh start, cell to land, save, exit, reload, death recovery; exported and launched on the owner's PC
Social foundation: a companion with a persistent identity (name, temperament, memory of the player)
Communication and dancing: sing, dance, charm and pose build a relationship; friend-or-foe stance before every interaction
One group task with allies and a persistent relationship scenario that survives save, reload and recovery checks
Lush stage music and effects for the cell, aquatic and creature stages that pass the feel rubric's feedback axis
Small HUD in every stage: goals top left, abilities bottom centre, one progress bar; feel rubric HUD axis 4+
Friend playtest: 3 to 5 players play the Windows build and answer five questions; findings filed as backlog items
Bounded content plan for the aquatic route through Social, Tribal and Civilization: what each era's underwater variant shares with the land version and what it adds; owner approves before any build
A fully aquatic lineage is never forced ashore: the Aquatic stage offers continuing into the Social era underwater, with the era gate explained
Underwater settlement slice: one functioning reef or seabed settlement and a neighbour, sharing the land settlement systems
Underwater city: connected settlements and routes on the sea floor; the same save and lineage carry over
